turns.replyText:
I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I completely get that, especially if you’ve been let down before. It’s a big deal to invest in plants and then have them not live up to what you expected.

A couple things that might help put your mind at ease about us:

All of our roses are premium own-root plants we grow ourselves at our nurseries in Oregon, not bought in from other growers.
They arrive in 1-gallon containers with soil, defoliated on purpose so they travel well and can put energy into new growth once planted.
Every rose is covered by a one-year guarantee, and our garden advisors can work with you if something doesn’t perform as expected.

From here, I want to match you with something that truly fits your situation instead of just “any” rose or plant.

Could you tell me:

What you’re shopping for (a rose, a particular color, a climber, something low-maintenance, etc.)
Your zip code or hardiness zone
Where it will go (full sun or some shade, in the ground or in a container)

Once I have those details, I can narrow it down to options that are both high quality and well-suited to your garden so you don’t have another disappointing experience.
